mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 55 degrees at Verona Community Park with clear skies, but keep in mind the air quality index is at 80. The moon is a waxing gibbous, and while the space station will pass overhead, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city has proposed the 2027 budget and is preparing for a November 4th plan commission meeting where they will review projects such as the Ardent Glen addition and site plans for Milky Way and Range Trail.

We have a busy weekend ahead with the Dane County Farmers Market today, plus live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, yoga begins on October 26, and trivia nights return on October 27 and 28.

On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I. Officers located the bus near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace, and thankfully, no students or members of the public were injured during the incident.
Today is the perfect day for a scoop of Turtle flavor. The shop is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
